continuity: The Bow Saint’s Force arrows destroy the fireballs falling on the battlefield; the Taeeul Merciless Sword and Roaring Fury Swordsman survive, both injured.
Fewer than five hundred Zhongnan Sect disciples remain; Hyuk Sopyung’s rally helps halt the Gansu Coalition Army’s retreat.
Taishan, Namho, Song Ilseom, Ju Hwaran, Hyuk Mujin, and Ma Junggeol are fighting toward Jin Taekyung; Mujin has a long wound in his side and Ma Junggeol has a dagger in his thigh.
A thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards led by Jeong Hogun arrive at the battlefield under the Emperor’s order to protect Jin Taekyung and attack his enemies.
plot: The Bow Saint’s Force arrows destroy the falling fireballs, saving the surviving Taeeul Merciless Sword and Roaring Fury Swordsman and letting the battered Zhongnan Sect disciples rally the Gansu Coalition Army. Taishan, Namho, Song Ilseom, Ju Hwaran, Hyuk Mujin, and Ma Junggeol fight through the battle while trying to reach Jin Taekyung; Mujin and Ma Junggeol are wounded.
A thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards led by Jeong Hogun charge into the battle under the Emperor’s order to protect Jin Taekyung and defeat his enemies, shifting the battlefield’s momentum.
translation_decisions: Retain the established renderings Force, Bow Saint, Embroidered Uniform Guard, Thousand Captain, and Marquis of Shangshan.
